name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. Originally a chef at a small tapas bar in Barcelona, he was drafted in to assist with a VIP event at the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya. The energy and precision of the paddock resonated with him, and he quickly adapted his skills to meet the demanding needs of the racing teams.

Ricardo prides himself on delivering not just sustenance, but an experience. He believes that well-fed mechanics and engineers are more effective, and he takes a hands-on approach to menu planning, sourcing the freshest local ingredients. His distinctive touch is the personalized service he provides, ensuring every team member feels valued and cared for. He approaches every meal as a strategic advantage.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a sturdy man of average height, with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down menu ideas.
Insists on personally tasting every dish before it's served.
Has a lucky paella pan that he brings to every race.
